title: 第1927章 旧犬不识故主面新途再启倒悬山第1926章 血影提颅惊众胆仙王请令动杀机
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：玄幻：长生神子，何须妹骨证道！第一卷：默认第1927章旧犬不识故主面，新途再启倒悬山！（..la）三个字落下的瞬间，如同三块千斤巨石砸入了平静的湖面。
前一秒还气的脸色通红的吕洋，脸色在一瞬间变得惨白如纸。
他的身体猛地一僵，那双三角眼中翻涌着极度的震惊、困惑与恐惧。
“顾长歌？！他怎么会在矿道里？！他不是进了秘境吗？！”
“才过去多久？就算秘境时间流速不同也绝不至于这么快就出来了？！”
赤炎峰长老同样面色大变。
“顾长歌？！你确定是这个名字？他怎么会出现在太初古矿的矿道里？！”
那名跪在地上的弟子连连摇头。
“弟子也不清楚！但他确实是这么自称的！而且他的长相……跟通缉令上的画像至少有七分相似！”
吕洋的拳头猛地攥紧。
但这一次，不是气的。
而是怕的。
他的脑海中飞速翻涌着无数念头，每一个念头都让他后背的冷汗越来越多。
“顾长歌明明进入了秘境……怎么可能这么快就出来了？！而且还是在矿道里大开杀戒？！”
“难道……这秘境的出口不止一个？！或者他在矿道那边还有什么同伙？！”
“是分身？还是本尊？”
“不对……这不对劲……太不对劲了……”
然而他没有时间细想了。
因为远处矿道的深处，已经传来了一阵沉重而急促的脚步声。
那脚步声如同鼓点般在空旷的矿道中回荡，越来越近、越来越清晰。

赤炎峰长老的老脸一白：
“跑！快跑！”
紫电峰长老同样没有任何犹豫地转身就跑。
“别管什么顾长歌了！先保住自己的命要紧！回去再商议对策！”
吕洋咬着牙，恶狠狠地看了一眼那道正在逼近的气息源头，然后猛地转身，化作一道淡金色的流光朝着传送阵的方向疾驰而去。
虽然他自信自己可以捏死一个人仙，但那是顾长歌啊，万一那小子有什么诡异手段，岂不是自寻死路？
初圣宗的几位长老如同被惊飞的鸟群般四散奔逃，连回头看一眼的勇气都没有。
而在那道脚步声传来的方向上，一条深邃的矿道阴影中，一道浑身浴血的身影正缓缓从中走出。
他的身形修长而挺拔，周身的衣袍已经被鲜血浸透成了暗红色，但那些血液中没有一滴是他自己的。
他的手中提着一颗硕大的头颅，颅骨上还残留着初圣宗长老服饰的碎片，断颈处的血液还在滴答滴答地往下淌。
那青年的面孔被血迹覆盖了大半，但依稀可以看出与顾长歌有七分相似。
只是比顾长歌更加坚毅、更加沧桑。
那双眼中没有渡劫境修士的锐利与锋芒，反而带着一种如同经历了无数场厮杀后沉淀下来的漠然与冷厉。
content_en:

Volume 1: Default Chapter 1927: The old dog does not recognize the true nature of the old man, and a new road begins to hang over the mountain! The moment the three words (..la) fell, it was like three huge rocks smashing into the calm lake.
Lu Yang, whose face was red with anger a second ago, turned pale as a sheet in an instant.
His body stiffened suddenly, and his triangular eyes were filled with extreme shock, confusion and fear.
"Gu Changge?! Why is he in the mine tunnel?! Didn't he enter a secret realm?!"
"How long has it been? Even if the speed of time in the secret realm is different, it will never come out so quickly?!"
Elder Chiyanfeng's expression also changed greatly.
"Gu Changge?! Are you sure that's his name? How could he appear in the tunnel of Taichu Ancient Mine?!"
The disciple who was kneeling on the ground shook his head repeatedly.
"My disciples don't know either! But that's what he calls himself! And his appearance... is at least 70% similar to the portrait on the wanted poster!"
Lu Yang's fists clenched suddenly.
But this time, it wasn't out of anger.
But fear.
Countless thoughts were rushing through his mind, and every thought made his back sweat more and more.
"Gu Changge clearly entered the secret realm...how could he come out so quickly?! And he was still killing people in the mine tunnel?!"
"Could it be that... there is more than one exit from this secret realm?! Or does he have any accomplices over there in the mine tunnel?!"
"Is it a clone? Or the original person?"
"No...this is wrong...so wrong..."
However, he had no time to dwell on it.
Because there was already a heavy and rapid sound of footsteps coming from the depths of the distant mine tunnel.
The footsteps echoed in the empty mine tunnel like drums, getting closer and closer and clearer.
Elder Chi Yanfeng’s old face turned pale:
"Run! Run!"
The elder of Zidian Peak also turned around and ran away without any hesitation.
"Don't worry about Gu Changge! It's important to save your own life first! We can discuss countermeasures when we go back!"
Lu Yang gritted his teeth and glanced viciously at the source of the approaching aura, then turned around suddenly and turned into a stream of light golden light and rushed towards the direction of the teleportation array.
Although he was confident that he could crush a human immortal to death, but that was Gu Changge. If that kid had any weird tricks, wouldn't he be asking for his own death?
Several elders of the Chu Sheng Sect fled in all directions like a flock of frightened birds, not even having the courage to look back.
In the direction from which the footsteps came, in the shadow of a deep mine tunnel, a figure covered in blood was slowly walking out of it.
His body was slender and tall, and the robes around him had been soaked in blood and turned dark red, but not a drop of the blood was his own.
He was holding a huge head in his hand, with fragments of the First Saint Sect elder's clothing still remaining on the skull, and the blood from the broken neck was still dripping down.
The young man's face was mostly covered in blood, but he could vaguely see a vague resemblance to Gu Changge.
It's just that he is more determined and vicissitudes than Gu Changge.
Those eyes did not have the sharpness and edge of a monk in the Tribulation Realm, but instead had a kind of indifference and coldness that seemed to have settled after countless battles.
